scientific_integrity: The general result rests on a self-contained averaging-and-normal-form proof. Independent mathematical validation and historical-priority adjudication have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite teams of distinct triples on a shared determinant, one relative-error atom and one exact atom, with named finite y and z alphabets. The theorem does not address disjoint-only splits, extra hidden variables, two approximate atoms, different determinants, or multiset teams. Historical priority is provisional; finite tests do not replace the general proof.
title: A sharp relative-error threshold for a common-determinant dependence split
